title: Covariance and expectation for juntas
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The covariance of the function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ induced by $\varphi$ through the coordinatewise binary-to-sign bijection with every Boolean function taking values in $\{\pm1\}$ and depending on at most $k$ coordinates is zero if and only if, for every such function, its expectation under $\varphi$ after the coordinatewise bijection equals its uniform mean on $\{\pm1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$
the quantified functions are Boolean functions $\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ depending on some set of at most $k$ coordinates
